status_definitions.pass: Directly established by source audit or evidence referenced in gate; for acceptance require a reproducible artifact
status_definitions.reported: Agent-reported success; not independently verified on current HEAD; excluded from pass count
status_definitions.pending: Not completed or not yet verified; excluded from pass count
status_definitions.failed: Observed failure; excluded from pass count

completion_rule: Each active P0 gate must be pass with evidence, no failed and no blocking issues. Code presence and acceptance evidence are separate.

local_windows_x64.build: Release with RequireCaptureEngine=true; existing pinned native assets and cached NuGet packages; no fresh dependency restore

checkpoints.manual_acceptance: Not executed. Prior game recognition observations remain smoke only. See the supervised handoff.
checkpoints.limitations: Latest custom/main push CI and enforcement of branch protection remain unverified.
